prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original low-magic medieval NPC pixel-art review board, THREE ROWS by TWO COLUMNS, six isolated full bodies. Uniform flat grey background, generous empty spacing, no text. Top row HERLIN, voluntary debt-hiding rivet repairman: lean middle-aged man with short dark-grey hair, tired guarded face, russet patched work tunic, dark trousers, leather apron tied at waist, small rivet hammer tucked safely at belt; hands relaxed, NO visible invented severe wound. Middle row AVI, his wife and independent temporary mender: adult woman with dark hair under faded blue kerchief, ochre-brown wool dress, linen sleeves, small sewing roll at belt, holds a plain repaired sleeve; attentive brisk stance, not hugging or obeying husband. Bottom row OSIN, workshop shift foreman: broad middle-aged man with shaved pate and short beard, charcoal work vest over muted olive tunic, heavy leather belt, folded gloves, robust boots; grounded arms loosely folded, not a soldier or union ruler. These are proposed original appearances, not canonical portraits. Independent pose references only: no shared meeting, reconciliation, signatures, payment, public disclosure or outcome. Hard visibly coarse pixel clusters, compact 40-logical-pixel-like adult game silhouettes enlarged cleanly, top-down oblique medieval RPG proportions, restrained earthy palette, selective dark outlines, simple faces, no painterly gradients, anti-aliased smoothness, glossy 3D, heroic armor, magic, symbols, labels or decorative scene.
